t: A free app for chatting with your own documents using local or cloud AI models.
steps: Download the desktop app from the AnythingLLM site.
Ask IT to approve the install on one test computer.
Choose the built-in local model engine or install Ollama.
Wait for the first model to download while the computer is online.
Create a workspace and upload one short document.
Ask three test questions and check each answer against the document.
Decide on a central model provider before students use it.
Use the Docker version and have an admin create users for shared use.
